dirty_boundary.handling: The untracked user-owned design document was not read as a data asset, modified, copied, or cleaned.

included: derived indexes and transient test databases
excluded: copying, normalizing, importing, or deleting any legacy asset
treating legacy results as Conflux-Weave capability evidence

hash_policy.text_files: Decode as UTF-8, normalize CRLF and CR to LF, then hash UTF-8 bytes.
hash_policy.directory_method: Sort repository-relative paths ordinally; hash each record as path + NUL + method + NUL + file hash + LF.
hash_policy.limitation: Directory hashes identify the captured inventory only; export must recompute per-file hashes in a new import manifest.

global_decisions: No asset is authorized for direct import into Conflux-Weave Runtime.
Legacy scores, traces, reports, and Runs remain historical evidence about legacy Conflux only.
Chroma and other derived indexes must be rebuilt from admitted Source Snapshots.
Documents require license, privacy, and relevance review before any selective export.
Every future export must create a new immutable manifest with source revision, selected paths, per-file hashes, normalization steps, and reviewer decision.

assets.purpose: Small Chinese/English RAG question-answer evaluation corpus.
assets.evidence_boundary: Candidate inputs only; historical expected answers and scores are not Weave results.
assets.reason: Small, reviewable, multilingual corpus relevant to W1 retrieval and cited-answer smoke tests; requires schema normalization and freshness review.

assets.purpose: Gold, replay, semantic, and candidate annotations around one EvidenceLedger limitation scenario.
assets.evidence_boundary: Contains seeded/manual labels plus candidate and replay variants; only an explicitly selected reviewed slice may be exported.
assets.reason: Useful as a bounded degradation/no-answer fixture, but too narrow to establish general RAG quality.

assets.purpose: Workflow, architecture, and sample-paper test fixtures.
assets.evidence_boundary: May support deterministic tests only and cannot prove live Provider, retrieval, or workflow capability.
assets.reason: Small and reviewable; export only fixtures consumed by an implemented Weave contract test.

assets.purpose: Legacy general-purpose golden questions and expected answers.
assets.evidence_boundary: No independent immutable manifest was found and some content is time-sensitive.
assets.reason: Superseded by better-scoped, manifested datasets; preserve for reference without promoting it.

assets.purpose: GIS and knowledge-graph paper radar candidates, rubric, and relevance labels.
assets.evidence_boundary: Labels were reviewed by Codex on the user's behalf from title and abstract, not independent full-text human review.
assets.reason: Potential W2 retrieval consumer exists, but W0/W1 has no radar consumer or normalized bibliographic schema.

assets.purpose: Knowledge-graph and LLM paper radar candidates and graded relevance labels.
assets.evidence_boundary: Abstract-level relevance annotations support later radar evaluation, not ontology truth or full-paper claims.
assets.reason: Relevant to a later KG/LLM radar consumer; importing before that consumer would create unused benchmark infrastructure.

assets.purpose: Constructed claim-verification and adversarial panel fixtures.
assets.evidence_boundary: Constructed and fixture-backed examples cannot be reported as real research or production evidence.
assets.reason: Potential deterministic verifier tests only; not a Runtime dataset and not a live quality benchmark.

assets.purpose: Historical M4/M5 evaluation configurations, merged metrics, recovery result, and live-repeat summaries.
assets.evidence_boundary: Retained failures and live-provider summaries describe legacy Conflux revisions and protocols only.
assets.reason: Useful for historical audit and protocol design; schema and implementation identity do not match Weave.

assets.purpose: Small source documents committed to legacy Conflux.
assets.evidence_boundary: Git tracking does not establish redistribution rights, currentness, relevance, or source authority.
assets.reason: Review license, privacy, authority, duplication, and a concrete W1/W2 consumer before selecting individual files.

assets.purpose: Local papers and research materials, including 99 PDFs.
assets.evidence_boundary: Not represented by the Git revision; ownership, license, privacy, and provenance are not established by this inventory.
assets.reason: Do not copy or commit. A future user-authorized import must select files explicitly and create source snapshots outside Git.

assets.evidence_boundary: Index identity does not prove source completeness, embedding version, admission policy, or reproducible lineage.
assets.reason: Weave indexes must be rebuilt from admitted Source Snapshots with an explicit embedding and normalization manifest.

assets.purpose: Historical summaries, traces, Markdown/HTML reports, logs, and evaluation databases.
assets.evidence_boundary: Static historical archive only; reports and traces must not be inserted as Weave Runs, Trace, Evidence, or evaluation results.
assets.reason: Preserve read-only for legacy audit; future migration must export a deliberately selected artifact with its original run identity.

assets.evidence_boundary: Authoritative for the captured legacy Runtime, not for Weave; zero Artifact rows also prevent treating all referenced history as self-contained.
assets.reason: Archive an immutable copy only under separate authorization; any later migration must use a versioned exporter and normalized import manifest.

assets.purpose: Secondary legacy local database with no Runs.
assets.evidence_boundary: No Run history; the single paper record is not sufficient reason to import the database.
assets.reason: Retain only if needed for legacy audit; otherwise reject during a separately approved migration review.

assets.purpose: Pytest-created Runtime and Chroma databases, including WAL/SHM sidecars.
assets.evidence_boundary: Temporary databases may support an individual test run only; they are neither fixtures nor migration inputs.
assets.reason: Exclude from export and import manifests. Regenerate through tests when needed.
